concept.literalSynthesis: A wand of vampire sparks bound into the stitched vampire suit: the wand identity supplies the bright ember, while the suit identity makes the same item wearable.
concept.coreMechanic: The active magic cast preserves the wand's 12-damage ember, 26-tick use interval, 4-mana base cost, gravity arc and small on-hit life return. The ember deals one magic hit and heals 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP per hit. This is deliberately a modest sustain rider rather than a source of free burst damage. Wearing the item grants 2 defense and +1 HP/s life regeneration; those benefits require the equipped slot and do not apply while merely holding it. The parents are both generation-depth 0; the wand is Blue rarity with 12 damage and the suit is White rarity with a 1 HP/s accessory regeneration effect. The combined design keeps the wand's damage, cadence and mana payment, and retains the suit's regeneration while adding a small explicit defense bonus. The source does not establish an acquisition tier, so rarity and value are retained as item facts rather than used to infer progression.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire-spark wand supplies the literal wand-and-ember identity and the active 12-damage magic cast, 26-tick cadence, 4-mana cost, gravity arc and capped hit-based healing. The active projectile remains a single-hit shot.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire suit supplies the wearable stitched-garment identity and the equipped life-regeneration role. A small positive defense bonus is an authored addition, not a claimed parent effect.
concept.playerExperience: Cast one cursor-aimed ember for 4 base mana; it arcs under gravity and can return at most 1 HP on a damaging hit. Equip the item for +2 defense and +1 HP/s. The equipment bonuses do not apply while the item is only held.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Spend the base mana cost to launch one gravity-affected magic ember toward the cursor; a damaging hit restores a small amount of life, capped at 1 HP.
Wear the stitched vampire item for its explicit defense and life-regeneration bonuses.

realization.description: Use the mantle to cast one 12-damage magic ember toward the cursor. Its initial speed is 26.25 blocks/s; gravity pulls it downward at 27 blocks/s², and its 1.5-second lifetime ends sooner if it hits a solid tile or damages an NPC. A damaging hit heals 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP for that hit. Each use animation has a base 4-mana cost and a 0.433-second use interval. While equipped, the item adds 2 defense and +1 HP/s regeneration. These equipment effects require the equipped slot.
realization.playerExperience: The active cast keeps the wand's measured cadence, mana cost and single-hit damage while its hit-based healing is capped at 1 HP. The garment's passive regeneration is retained and paired with an explicit modest defense bonus; neither passive applies from holding the item in inventory.
